decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel extends the proven BASIC 518, which already has many satisfied users, so its results likely meet the aspiration and fit the core mobile screening business that a lean, restructured firm would protect.

The flail shredder line fits the core mobile-processing portfolio and survived the 2019 pruning, so management keeps it, though little slack is left and continued weak evidence would trigger problemistic search.

The stationary electric fine shredder has stayed barely visible and sits in the stationary segment the firm already partly left by dropping the pre-shredders, so with scarce slack its resources are better spent on the established mobile business and new development.
